blocks.text: Gemini 3.5 Pro is a proprietary language model from Google, released on Jul 17, 2026.
Pricing for this model has not been publicly confirmed at time of writing.
Its context window of 2.1M tokens ranks #2 of 41 for context depth in this dataset.
It targets long-context, reasoning, vision workloads.
2M context; Deep Think reasoning mode; in limited Vertex preview only as of this writing.
No independently verified benchmark scores are available for this model. Scores are only shown when independently confirmed with a source URL.
